editorial: Your quiet suburban life shatters when a mysterious foster mother arrives, and you feel the tension settling in the air. Unlike conventional horror, the film leans into psychological dread, letting a single chilling revelation unfold over nearly an hour. Maya Hawke’s subdued performance turns each glance into a silent warning. However, the pacing slows noticeably in the second act, risking a brief lull. Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
